name: Vibe
summary: Self-serve streaming and connected TV advertising platform with a built-in video ad generator, no contract and a minimum daily spend.
best_for: small and mid-size brands that want to run streaming TV ads themselves, with a generated video ad and no contract
skip_if: you need proof that TV ads bring sales before you spend, or you cannot commit at least $50 a day
honest_knock: Vibe sells ad spend, so cost depends on delivery: the pricing page gives CPM from $15 to $40 and a $50 a day minimum, and the budget step suggested $100 a day. We did not publish a campaign, so we saw no delivery or results. A Traffic campaign needs the Vibe pixel on your site. The generated ad used screenshots of our site that included other brands, and the end card kept a placeholder.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Minimum daily ad spend · per usage, no subscription
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-22 on vibe.co/pricing, USD) No subscription: you pay for the ads you run. CPM $15 to $40 depending on channel and time, minimum spend $50 a day, no contract and no commitment, paid by credit card or wire. The pricing page lists targeting, Vibe Studio, reporting, A/B testing, automatic and manual bidding, and 24/7 support as included. Banner on 22 November 2026: spend $5,000 on streaming TV ads, get $5,000 in bonus ad credits. In our test the budget step filled in $100 a day and a card was asked for before publishing.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 in the Vibe web app with the interface in English. We signed up with email and a verification code, built an Awareness campaign for our own site up to the budget step, let Vibe Studio generate the video ad, and stopped at the payment step. No card was entered and no campaign went live.
findings: Sign up: no card was asked to create the account. After the email code the dashboard opened with our site already set up as the advertiser.
Campaign types: a Traffic campaign needed a Vibe Page View event on the advertiser's website before we could continue; an Awareness campaign did not.
Budget step: a $100 daily budget and all 569 apps and channels across the US were filled in by default. The estimate showed 23K to 47K impressions and 1.56K to 3.11K households a week.

Creative: Generate a creative built a 30 second video from screenshots of our site, with music, a QR code and an AI voice reading a script written from our site text, in about a minute. The end card kept a [phone number here] placeholder until edited, and some slides showed other brands that appear on our pages.
Payment: Publish Campaign required a card on the summary step, with consent to charge it for future payments. The pricing page lists a $50 a day minimum and CPM from $15 to $40 on 22 November 2026.
not_tested: a live campaign: publishing needs a card and we did not publish, so we saw no delivery, reporting or results
